Roma.reason: refers to the Roma ethnic group mentioned as a target of hate speech, not the language

Yine.reason: refers to the Turkish word 'yine' meaning 'again', not a language

Danish.reason: refers to Danish nationality/people in an example phrase, not the Danish language

Greek.reason: refers to Greek people/anti-Greek sentiment, not the Greek language

Turkish.reason: refers to the Turkish language, with datasets and BERTurk models built for Turkish hate speech detection

Arabic.reason: refers to the Arabic language, with datasets and AraBERT models built for Arabic hate speech detection

English.reason: refers to the English language only in related work discussion, not studied in the paper
